title: Our Town Park
text:
Our town has a big park. Many people walk there every day. The park has old trees and a small lake. Birds live in the trees and near the water.

Last year, the town made a new rule. People must put plastic bottles in a special bin. Now the park is cleaner, and the birds are happier. Children also help to pick up rubbish on Saturdays.

options: Old trees and a small lake

questions.text: Where must people put plastic bottles?
What kind of people live in this town?
options: People who care about the environment
People who do not like birds
People who want to cut down the trees

questions.text: What can we guess about the park now?
options: It has been closed for years

vocabulary.definition: a large public area with grass and trees where people can relax
things that you throw away because you do not need them
a container where you put things you want to throw away

paragraph_translations: Nasze miasto ma duży park. Wielu ludzi chodzi tam każdego dnia. Park ma stare drzewa i małe jezioro. Ptaki mieszkają na drzewach i w pobliżu wody.

W zeszłym roku miasto wprowadziło nowe przepisy. Ludzie muszą wrzucać plastikowe butelki do specjalnego kosza. Teraz park jest czystszy, a ptaki są szczęśliwsze. Dzieci pomagają też zbierać śmieci w soboty.
